headline: Euro Zone Economic Growth Beats Projections Again
summary: Euro zone economic growth exceeded consensus projections once more, signaling stronger-than-expected regional macroeconomic resilience.
why: Positive growth surprises in the euro area reduce recession concerns and influence European Central Bank monetary policy expectations.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Better-than-expected regional GDP growth supports currency valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger GDP figures defied conservative forecasts, improving macroeconomic sentiment regarding the euro zone economy.
